summary:
Here’s a summary of the call:

Mike Ross called HomeNet because his internet service has been consistently unreliable for two weeks without resolution. The agent escalated the issue to their network team due to its priority nature, providing complete account history and a credit for the affected period. After confirming the situation, the agent offered personal follow-up and provided a reference number for updates.

ratings.name: Branding and Survey
ratings.reason: The agent used the correct greeting and offered a post-call survey.

ratings.name: Personalized the Call
ratings.reason: – The agent acknowledged Mike’s name and started by expressing empathy, which was appropriate given his frustration.

ratings.name: Empathy and Acknowledgment
ratings.reason: – The agent responded to the customer's feelings ("I really don’t want to lose you") demonstrating understanding of their situation.

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: The agent maintained a respectful tone throughout the conversation, avoiding interruptions and using polite language. [RoBERTa flagged 1 harsh agent line(s)]

ratings.name: Paraphrasing
ratings.reason: – The agent restated the customer’s issue in their own words (“My internet has been unreliable for two weeks…”) to confirm comprehension.

ratings.name: Verified Customer
ratings.reason: – The agent validated Mike's name and account details before escalating the issue.

ratings.name: Probing
ratings.reason: The agent asked probing questions about the specific problem ("And still nothing has changed.") to understand the root cause of the issue.

ratings.name: Set Proper Expectations
ratings.reason: – The agent provided accurate expectations regarding the resolution process, including a follow-up action.

ratings.name: Provided the Solution
ratings.reason: – The agent offered a credit for the affected period as a start to the resolution.

ratings.name: Took Ownership
ratings.reason: The agent took responsibility and stated they would personally follow up on the ticket.

ratings.name: Active Listening
ratings.reason: – The agent listened attentively to Mike’s concerns without interrupting or becoming defensive.

ratings.name: Confirmed Resolution
ratings.reason: – The agent confirmed that the issue was resolved, offering an update.

suggestions: Customer intends to switch providers due to ongoing issues.
Investigate the root cause of the problem immediately – check network logs and equipment status.
Provide Mike Ross with a detailed explanation of the escalation process and timeline for resolution.

compliance.name: Discourtesy
compliance.rule: Never be discourteous: no profanity, bashing, impatience, or sarcasm toward the customer

compliance.name: Escalation
compliance.rule: Escalate to a supervisor when the customer asks

compliance.name: Call Avoidance
compliance.rule: Do not avoid the call: never refuse to help or push the customer away without a valid reason
